Dev diary #3: Yes, I modelled the back

A few of you asked whether the Elder has a back, or whether I'd just been clever with camera angles. It has a back. It has 118,000 voxels and most of them are crest, and I spent a week on a side nobody will see unless they rotate the EvoDex.

That week also fixed something real: the turn-around views are now what the game uses for the Evolution screen, so the reveal spins the whole creature instead of flipping a sprite. It looks like a toy on a turntable. I'm happy with it.

THIS WEEK
- Elder turnaround in the game, all six colours.
- Health Connect background sync on Android (overnight walks count).
- Rest days: two protected days a week, so a cold doesn&#39;t make your Evochi sick.
